corpus: six public-domain federal documents: three NFIP flood policy forms (Dwelling, General Property, Condominium) that share most of their text, plus the FTC Cooling-Off Rule, the FTC Mail Order Rule, and OSHA injury recordkeeping (29 CFR 1904)
notes: Three categories. Every 'answerable' question is about something unique to one document, so 'which document' is a real test with three near-identical flood forms in the corpus. 'not_in_corpus' must be refused. 'out_of_scope' asks for advice and must be refused.

cases.question: Under the condominium building policy, when is a coinsurance penalty imposed?
Within how many hours must an employer report a work-related fatality to OSHA?
cases.expect_phrase: Within eight (8) hours after the death

cases.question: Within how many hours must an employer report an in-patient hospitalization, amputation, or loss of an eye to OSHA?
cases.expect_phrase: Within twenty-four (24) hours after the in-patient hospitalization

cases.question: How many years must an employer keep the OSHA injury and illness records?
cases.expect_phrase: for five (5) years following the end of the calendar year

cases.question: Which employers are partially exempt from routine OSHA recordkeeping by size?
cases.expect_phrase: 10 or fewer employees at all times during the last calendar year

cases.question: Within how many calendar days of learning of a recordable injury must an employer enter it on the OSHA forms?
cases.expect_phrase: within seven (7) calendar days of receiving information that a recordable

cases.question: Under the FTC Mail Order Rule, by when must a seller ship if no time is stated?
cases.expect_phrase: within thirty (30) days after receipt of a properly completed order

cases.question: Under the Mail Order Rule, how must a refund be sent when the original payment was by cash, check, or money order?
cases.expect_phrase: as fast and reliable as first class mail

cases.question: By when can a buyer cancel a door-to-door sale under the Cooling-Off Rule?
cases.expect_phrase: prior to midnight of the third business day

cases.question: Under the Cooling-Off Rule, what purchase price makes a sale at the buyer's residence a door-to-door sale?
cases.expect_phrase: purchase price of $25 or more if the sale is made at the buyer's residence

cases.question: The Dwelling Form flood policy insures what kind of residential building?
cases.expect_phrase: one to four family residential building, not under a condominium

cases.question: How many days after a flood loss must a proof of loss be sent under the Dwelling Form?
cases.expect_phrase: send us a proof of loss, which is your statement

cases.question: What is the special limit for artwork, jewellery and similar personal property under the Dwelling Form?
cases.expect_phrase: We will pay no more than $2,500 for any one loss

cases.question: Does any of the flood policies cover loss caused by earth movement such as landslide or sinkholes?
cases.expect_phrase: We do not insure for loss to property caused directly by earth movement

cases.question: Which days do not count as a business day under the Cooling-Off Rule?
cases.expect_phrase: Any calendar day except Sunday or any federal holiday
